_comment: The receiver's image (firmware/mkimage.py): its app area only, written at SPI 0x11000 by fw-re/jlflash.sh. The receiver boots its own loader from SPI 0x0 (isd_config EOFFSET 0x10), which finds the app area through the JLFS header at 0x10000; neither is written. The areas are where the chip keeps them (docs/dongle.md). The 4 KB at 0x60000 hold the installer's record (0x60FF0): the image must end before it.
